name: JEM — Judiciary Entity Map
install: cd jem && pip install --user -r scripts/requirements-dev.txt && python3 scripts/build_db.py --force

terminals.name: api
terminals.description: JEM Researcher API (FastAPI): REST at /api/v1, MCP tools at /mcp, Swagger UI at /docs. Reads jem/data/jem.db.

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Static vanilla-JS map frontend. Open http://127.0.0.1:8080/ ; loads /public/graph.json and calls the API on 127.0.0.1:8001.
